description: Language-neutral golden vectors for the money twin (pkg/hub/money <-> @hara/sdk-money). All numeric inputs and outputs are strings to avoid JSON float precision loss. Error cases are matched by error identity (Go exception sentinel / TS MoneyError.code), never message text. See conformance/README.md.

cases.note: half away from zero: exact half rounds up (plan 005)
half away from zero: negative exact half rounds away (plan 005)
half away from zero: small exact half rounds up (plan 005)
below half rounds down
above half rounds away from zero
Absolute(MinInt64) is unrepresentable in int64; both runtimes return 0 (plan 005)
MinInt64+1 negates to MaxInt64
ordinary negative
ordinary sum
Add(MaxInt64, 1) overflows; both runtimes raise the overflow error (plan 005)
ordinary difference
Subtract(MinInt64, 1) overflows; both runtimes raise the overflow error (plan 005)
ordinary product with negative factor
Multiply(MaxInt64, 2) overflows; both runtimes raise the overflow error (plan 005)
major-unit float scaled by currency fraction, half away from zero (plan 005)
below half rounds down
negative half away from zero
exact-integer conversion above the float-safe range (2^53 + 1) x 2.0 (plan 006)
MaxInt64 x 2.0 leaves the int64 range; both runtimes raise the overflow error (plan 006)
fraction reduction 2->0 with half-away rounding (plan 006)
negative fraction reduction with half-away rounding (plan 006)
aggregator average: positive half minor unit rounds away from zero
aggregator average: negative half minor unit rounds away from zero
aggregator average: below-half fraction rounds toward zero
aggregator average: above-half fraction rounds away from zero
aggregator average: negative below-half fraction rounds toward zero
aggregator average: negative above-half fraction rounds away from zero
bare integer amount: the form both marshallers emit
quoted integer amount: the form TS toJSON() emits, so unmarshal must read back its own output
quoted amount past 2^53: the reason toJSON() quotes at all, exact in both runtimes
bare fractional amount rounds half away from zero
quoted fractional amount rounds identically to the bare form
quoted negative half rounds away from zero
quoted exponent form is a JSON number literal and decodes as one
absent amount is zero, not an error
a quoted amount must still be a number
empty string is not a number; distinct from an absent amount
no whitespace tolerance inside the quotes, so the quoted grammar is anchored not prefix-matched
a non-numeric, non-string amount is rejected
